title: Windows winkernel proxier drops HNS v1

detection.reason: the HNS API version a Windows node offers is host state, not a Kubernetes object — nothing in the collected inventory distinguishes an HNS v1 node from an HNS v2 one

quote: Windows winkernel kube-proxy no longer supports Windows HNS v1 APIs.
remediation: Only Windows nodes are affected. Confirm each one runs an HNS v2-capable Windows Server build before upgrading; kube-proxy will not start on a node offering only HNS v1.
verifyCommand: kubectl get nodes -l kubernetes.io/os=windows -o name  # each node printed runs the winkernel proxier; check the HNS version it offers before upgrading
